definitions.explanation: Describes something that has just been roasted or pan-roasted, typically coffee beans, sesame seeds, or tea. Emphasizes the freshness and aroma.

examples.japanese: {煎|い}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Freshly roasted coffee has a wonderful aroma.

examples.japanese: {煎|い}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I sprinkled freshly roasted sesame seeds on the dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煎|い}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: At this shop, you can enjoy coffee made with freshly roasted beans.

notes:
USAGE:
Part of the 〜たて pattern meaning "freshly done." Most commonly used with coffee beans and sesame seeds. The aroma is often emphasized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煎|い}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧ (freshly roasted coffee)
- {煎|い}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧ (freshly roasted beans)
- {煎|い}り{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧ (freshly roasted sesame)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧: freshly baked — just out of the oven
- ⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧: freshly fried — just out of the fryer
